principles: Learning records are advisory context, never proof or DONE gate evidence.
Candidate playbooks remain inert until the existing explicit activation boundary is invoked.
Outcome recording must require concrete exposure and structured verdict source for positive helped claims.
Implementation should reuse the existing learning-store, digest, and write-lock patterns instead of introducing a parallel subsystem.
Command surfaces must remain host-neutral and agent-neutral.
drivers: Existing playbook lifecycle already has propose/diff/approve/activate/reject and should not be reworked.
The V1 plan requires assessment-loop foundation but not automatic activation or scheduled workers.
Concurrent hosts can write learning artifacts, so shared write discipline must be preserved.

options.name: A: Add append-only playbook outcome ledger plus host-neutral playbook_outcome_record command
pros: Smallest real correctness fix for the missing outcome lifecycle.
Reuses .lattice/learning owner-root, canonical JSON, and playbook write-lock patterns.
Keeps activation and runtime surfacing unchanged while enabling later evaluator work.
cons: Does not yet recommend activation or rejection; later M4-M6 stories still need evaluator/status surfaces.
Adds one more learning artifact that must be validated and documented in process fact metadata.

options.name: B: Implement full promotion sweep and recommendation evaluator now
pros: Would close more of the plan in one story.
cons: Larger blast radius and more risk of arbitrary optimization before ledger primitives are proven.
Would mix M0-M2 foundation with M4-M6 policy logic and make review less crisp.

options.name: C: Only document the future worker and skip code changes
pros: No runtime risk and no new CLI command.
cons: Leaves candidate outcome recording missing, so generated candidates still cannot be assessed mechanically.
Does not satisfy the user request to start development.

chosen: A: Add append-only playbook outcome ledger plus host-neutral playbook_outcome_record command
rationale: Option A is the narrowest correctness fix: it gives Proofbound an auditable outcome ledger while preserving the explicit activation boundary and avoiding V2 policy work.

preMortem.scenario: Candidate helped is inferred from ordinary story DONE success.
preMortem.trigger: Outcome command or tests allow helped with no exposureMode or verdictSource.
preMortem.consequence: Learning loop records false positives and may recommend bad playbooks later.
preMortem.mitigation: Reject helped unless exposureMode is concrete and verdictSource is structured; add smoke assertions for this.

preMortem.scenario: Outcome recording accidentally mutates active runtime guidance.
preMortem.trigger: Implementation increments active usage counters or changes status during outcome record.
preMortem.consequence: Candidate playbooks could become runtime advice without explicit activation.
preMortem.mitigation: Write only append-only outcome records and keep playbook status unchanged; assert gateEvidence=false.

preMortem.trigger: Outcome command writes without the existing shared playbook write lock or owner-root resolution.
preMortem.consequence: Concurrent agents could lose records or split stores between worktrees.
preMortem.mitigation: Use withPlaybookWriteLock and resolveLearningOwnerRoot; verify append preserves existing records.
